description: Header file defining utility functions for handling cJSON objects, including size calculation and serialization to string.

methods.name: size_t get_cjson_blob_size(const cJSON * const json)
methods.description: Calculates the size in bytes of a cJSON JSON string representation by converting the cJSON object to a string and measuring its length.

methods.name: std::string stringify(cJSON * blob,bool unformatted=false)
methods.description: Converts a cJSON blob into its string representation, either formatted or unformatted based on the flag.

ctags.pattern: /^	static inline size_t get_cjson_blob_size(const cJSON *const json) {$/
